title: feat(types,plugin-view,app-shell)!: ObjectViewSchema.listViews mirrors the spec's ObjectListViewSchema by reference; ViewPreview folds a stored options bag (objectui#7928)
body:
Fixes #7928
Clause-②: yes

Ruling `5856694523` (director seat, Q1 A · Q2 (i)), under ruling `5565628927` (option A, staged, maintainer 「同意」). Claim `5857418366`, seat `domain:spec#1`, session `session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW`.

## What changed

- **`@object-ui/types`: the mirror flips by reference.**
  - The zod face: `ObjectViewSchema.listViews` is `stripImportedDefaults(SpecViewSchema).shape.listViews`. That is the spec container's own record of the strict `ObjectListViewSchema`, crossed through the import boundary so no protocol default is written into a parsed document.
  - The TS face: a record of string to `z.input` of `typeof ObjectListViewSchema`, imported type-only from `@objectstack/spec/ui`.
  - A named view authoring `options` is refused `unrecognized_keys`, naming `options`.
  - The `UnmirroredDeclared` ledger row is deleted. The header figures moved to 12 entries / 84 keys (2 / 16 spec-derived), each with its history sentence.
  - The two ledger comments triage `5853448361` names are rewritten.
- **`@object-ui/app-shell` `ViewPreview`: the fold.** The new `foldStoredListOptions` lifts each `options.KIND` of a stored body onto the top-level `KIND` block before the node is built. The top-level value wins per key, and `options` is not relayed. A body without `options` comes back as the same object.
- **`@object-ui/plugin-view` `ObjectView`: both named-view `options` reads are removed.** They are the `legacyViewOptions` rung and the `options:` relay into the `list-view` node. The host `activeView` rung stays on both, so objectui#10758 / #10380's path is untouched. The JSDoc example now teaches the canonical `kanban` / `calendar` blocks. `currentNamedViewConfig` is typed off `ObjectViewSchema['listViews']`.
- **`NamedListView` is untouched** (Q2 (i)).
- **`examples/byo-backend-console`**: the named view gains per-object `columns`.
- **Changeset** `7928-listviews-by-reference-fold.md`: `minor` for types / plugin-view / app-shell, with the breaking semantics spelled out.

## Beyond the claimed file surface, and why each was forced

Every item below is a measured consequence of the flip. None is a new capability.

1. **The two named-view door checks now run under `superRefine(…, { when })`, and they read the protocol's refusal.**
   - The checks are objectui#8355's calendar aliases and objectui#10321's stray `kanban.groupBy`, which landed on `main` mid-card and was merged in.
   - The strict record refuses the alias itself. That aborts a default refinement, and the parse output DROPS the key. Measured: without the change, the checks never ran on the documents they exist for.
   - The author would then see only the protocol's near-miss hint, which for `dateField` says `endDateField`: the hazard objectui#8355's docblock names.
   - A shared helper, `namedViewKindRefusals`, reads the `unrecognized_keys` issue at `listViews.KEY.KIND` and adds the pointer at the key. It adds messages only. It refuses and accepts nothing on its own.
   - The `options.KIND` nesting is not judged any more. The bag is refused whole.
2. **plugin-view tab strip: a named view's `label` is resolved as the protocol's `I18nLabel`.** It uses `resolveI18nLabel` with `useDisplayLocale`, as `ListView` already does.
   - Measured on the flipped tree before the fix: a locale-map label threw "Objects are not valid as a React child".
   - The contract now declares that shape, so it has to render.
3. **plugin-view sort reads.** The protocol's named-view `sort` (17.4.0) still admits the bare string clause objectui retired (objectui#8221).
   - The two sink reads cast to the sink's declared input and hand the value on unchanged. The sinks refuse a string out loud (`normalizeSortEntries`, `ObjectGrid`). Nothing is narrowed, dropped or lowered.
   - A pin (`ObjectView.namedViewSpecRecord-7928.test.tsx`) reads that answer: no `$orderby`, and the refusal is reported.
4. **Pins that asserted the unmirrored state are inverted. ⛔ None is deleted.**
   - #8980's three legacy-nesting cases.
   - #8355's legacy-nesting arm, scope controls and TIMELINE control, on both the plugin-view and the types side.
   - #10321's legacy nesting and scope controls.
   - The objectui#7924 census in `object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`: `options` moves from read to unread (20 / 44), and bucket ③ is 11. `options` is HELD, not tombstoned, per Q2 (i). The value-binding instrument now also recognises `NamedViewConfig`, the mirrored member's entry type.
   - `object-view-spec-parity` (the TS-only backlog is empty; 22 / 24 keys).
   - `imported-defaults-8317`: `ViewSchema` is registered, and a fourth `lazy` node sits under `formViews`. The walker docblock count moved with it.
5. **Three plugin-view fixture files** typed as `ObjectViewSchema`: named views gain `columns`, and a tuple filter is respelled as a rule object. The assertions are unchanged.
6. **Three reference rows** (`schema-reference.md`, `plugin-view.mdx`, plugin-view README) said a `listViews` entry is a `NamedListView`.

## Verification, first taken at `24bcb00353` (after an earlier merge of `main`)

The readings in this section are of `24bcb00353`. The base-merge round re-took them at the final head `395371dad2`; see Patch round 1 below.

Every heavy run went through `os-verify-lock.sh`. Each exit code was captured redirect-first.

- vitest `packages/types/ packages/plugin-view/`: 301 files, 5854 tests passed, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- vitest `packages/plugin-list/` plus 71 app-shell files: 173 files, 1816 tests passed, exit 0.
  - The app-shell files are those reaching `ViewPreview` or the preview registry, `ObjectView*` and `InterfaceListPage*`.
  - The full app-shell suite (831 files) is declared to CI. app-shell's only source change is `ViewPreview.tsx`.
- type-check (`tsc --noEmit` plus `tsconfig.test.json`), exit 0 each: `@object-ui/types` (plus examples), plugin-view, app-shell, plugin-list, and `examples/byo-backend-console`.
- Reverse verification of the cross-package type: before the fixtures were respelled, plugin-view's `tsconfig.test.json` went red with TS2741 "Property 'columns' is missing" against the rebuilt `.d.ts`.
- ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the 20 touched TS/TSX files: 0 errors, 200 warnings.
  - The only new warning is `react-refresh/only-export-components` for the exported fold in `ViewPreview.tsx`.
  - Not type-aware: `eslint.config.js` has no `projectService` / `parserOptions` (count 0, control `languageOptions` 1), so no untouched file's verdict can move.
- Gates, exit 0 each:
  - `check-changeset-presence` (19 source files of 3 released packages, 1 changeset) and `check-changeset-no-major`.
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:test-path-roots`.
  - The three `check:vi-mock-*` gates and `check-changeset-claims`.
  - `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-snippets` (676 of 676 judged, 0 failed), `check:doc-examples`, `check:readme-exports`, `check:doc-fences`.
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED).
- **Spec Main Shape Gate: NOT MEASURED locally.** It is a repo-wide forced type-check against a spec built from objectstack `main`, which CI runs on this PR. Source reading of objectstack `main` (`e4621867`): `ViewSchema.listViews` is the same record, and the list-view `sort` is array-only there, so the sort casts narrow nothing.

**Ablations.** Each used `ablation-replace.mjs`, on the committed tree, with the restore proven (`git diff HEAD` empty, blob equals HEAD):

1. The fold call replaced by the raw body: 3 of 12 red (the legacy lane, the per-key survival, the contract parse). "Canonical wins" stays green, because the renderer no longer reads the bag.
2. The named-view `options` read restored: 4 red (two inverted #8980 cases, the fold file's CONTROL, #8355's half-1 legacy control).
3. `when` dropped from the door checks: 4 red (the canonical `calendar.dateField` / `endField` pointer pins, types and plugin-view).
4. The tab-strip label resolution reverted: the locale-map case and the empty-map fall-through went red, and the plain-string CONTROL stayed green.
5. The kanban sibling unwired (merged head): the two #10321 pointer pins went red, and every control stayed green.

## Patch round 1: base merge (final head `395371dad2`)

After #10793 (`66e8b2ab38`) and #10802 (`b956e693d0`) landed, `origin/main` `b956e693d0` was merged into this branch as merge commit `9c2a692186`. Both landed commits were confirmed as its ancestors first. There was no rebase and no force-push.

- **`imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`**: the `IMPORTED` list keeps both crossings. `ChartSeriesSchema` (objectui#10770) comes first, then `ViewSchema` (this PR). The walker's `lazy` count stays 4, since `ChartSeriesSchema` owns no `z.lazy`.
- **`object-view-unmirrored-keys-7779.test.ts`**: the describe takes `main`'s "seventeen `?: never` tombstones". The first `it()` checks 8 + (11 − 1 − 1) = 17 tombstones derived off the AST, which is `main`'s `NAMED_LIST_VIEW_TOMBSTONES` with `densityMode`. #10793's assertions (`_DensityModeTombstoned`, `_refusedDensityMode`, `_acceptedDensityCanonical`, and the relay fold-through lines) and this PR's (`listViews` by reference, `BUCKET_LOCAL_ONLY_HELD`, and "`options` is HELD") all survive, and no assertion was re-pointed. Four comment passages were re-pointed to the merged state: bucket ③ is eleven, `options` is the held eleventh member, and the retained read quotes Q2 (i).
- **`plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx`** merged cleanly, and the two edits have no semantic collision. #10793's `rowHeight` rung reads `normalizeListViewSchema(activeView ?? {})`, while this PR dropped the `currentNamedViewConfig?.options` reads: there are 0 on the merged file, with `currentNamedViewConfig?.kanban` at 1 as the control.
- **Changeset.** `395371dad2` re-points one paragraph that the merge made false: the entry leaves `NamedListView` unchanged, #7924's own entry retires its `densityMode`, and any further retirement follows ruling A′ and the `allowExport` ruling (`5856694523` Q2 (i)).

**Readings at the merged tree.** Every heavy run went through the lock, and each exit code was read before any pipe.
- `type-check` exited 0 for `@object-ui/types`, `core`, `plugin-view`, `app-shell` and `plugin-charts`, and also for `plugin-list` and `examples/byo-backend-console`.
- vitest:

  | package | files | tests |
  | --- | --- | --- |
  | `types` | 257 | 5482 |
  | `core` | 182 | 3635 |
  | `plugin-view` | 52 | 490 |

  | `plugin-list` | 104 | 1173 |

  All passed with exit 0.
- **`app-shell` exited 1: 838 files passed, 1 failed and 1 skipped (8551 tests passed, 1 failed, 9 skipped).**
  - The failure is `AppContent.inaccessibleAppStrand.test.tsx`, "bounces to the DECLARED landing…". Its network-escape guard fired on a real socket to `localhost:3000/api/v1/meta`.
  - The same file passed alone 3 of 3. It is outside this diff, which touches nothing under `app-shell/src/console`.
  - This is recorded, not waived. CI's sharded run on this head decides it.
- The named pins passed together: 7 files, 411 tests (the 7779, 8317 and 7928 pins, `ViewPreview.optionsFold-7928`, `ObjectView.densityModeThroughFold-7924` and `ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559`).
- ESLint `--no-inline-config` on the 20 TS/TSX files: 0 errors and 200 warnings, the same as at `24bcb00353`.
- Gates at `395371dad2` exited 0 each:
  - `check-changeset-presence` and `check-changeset-no-major`;
  - `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:spec-symbols` and `check:test-path-roots`;
  - the three `check:vi-mock-*` gates, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences` and `check-changeset-claims`;
  - `check-governed-queue-guard --test`: 24 paths, NOT GOVERNED.
- **Reverse check.** Writing `24bcb00353`'s 7779 pin over the merge turned vitest red on #10793's tombstone: 3 failed, exit 1. `tsconfig.test.json` also went red, with TS2344 and TS2322. The restore was proven: the blob equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **NOT MEASURED:**
  - `check:readme-exports`: its prerequisite is not met (unbuilt dists).
  - `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples`: not re-run, because this PR's doc lines are byte-identical to `24bcb00353`, where both passed.
  - The Spec Main Shape Gate: CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- **The named view now has one dialect, and it is wider in two ways and stricter in more.**
  - Keys the protocol's strict kind blocks do not declare are refused on a named view. Measured on 17.4.0: `kanban.titleField` / `groupField` / `swimlaneField` / `conditionalFormatting`, `gallery.imageField`, `timeline.dateField` / `endField`, `calendar.allDayField` / `defaultView` and `map.style`.
  - `generateViewSchema` still reads them off a named view that reaches it unvalidated, so a stored body keeps rendering.
  - This is ruling A's "by reference". It is not the stop condition (a third top-level `options` read), but it is a larger population than the thread measured (top-level members only).
  - `kanban.titleField`, `calendar.defaultView` and `map.style` have no protocol spelling on this surface. Whether any deserves one is an upstream question for the seat.
- **Release text.** Pending changesets for objectui#7779, #8355, #10321, #8365 and #9242 say `listViews` stays unmirrored, or that the doors judge the `options` nesting. This PR's changeset states that it supersedes both, rather than editing five other cards' bodies.
- **Left as found, deliberately:**
  - `NamedListView`'s own docblock still says "Used in ObjectViewSchema.listViews". Under Q2 (i) the interface is untouched. objectui#7924 closed via #10793, which retired only `densityMode` and left this docblock as it was. The director seat carries it as a hygiene card (record `5860951313` ③).
  - The dev-mode warning in `generateViewSchema` still tells authors to "Move them under options.KIND"; it now reads the host `views` entry only.
  - `normalizeSortEntries`' refusal text says the array is "the only one `@objectstack/spec` accepts". That is false for 17.4.0's `ObjectListViewSchema` and true on objectstack `main`.
- **Overlap, resolved.** #10793 (objectui#7924) and #10802 (objectui#10770) each conflicted textually with this PR: #10793 in the describe and first `it()` names of the 7779 census, and #10802 in the 8317 `IMPORTED` list. Both landed first. Merge commit `9c2a692186` resolved both conflicts and kept every assertion from both sides (Patch round 1).
